verses.1: The lazy man is pelted with a dirty stone, and all will speak about his rejection.
verses.2: The lazy man is pelted with the dung of oxen, and all who touch him will brush off their hands.
verses.3: An undisciplined son is the shame of his father, but an undisciplined daughter will be to his degradation.
verses.4: A prudent daughter brings an inheritance to her husband. But she who causes shame will be a disgrace to him who conceived her.
verses.5: She who is bold shames her father and her husband, and she will not be less offensive to the impious. For she will be held in dishonor by both.
verses.6: An untimely explanation is like music in a time of mourning. But the sharp correction and doctrine of wisdom are ever timely.
verses.7: Whoever teaches the foolish is like someone who glues together a broken pot.
verses.8: Whoever explains a word to one who is not listening is like someone who suddenly awakens a sleeping person from a deep sleep.
verses.9: Whoever explains wisdom to the senseless is like one speaking to a sleeping person. And at the end of the explanation, he says: “Who is this?”
verses.10: Weep over the dead, for his light has failed. And weep over the foolish, for his understanding has failed.
verses.11: Weep only a little over the dead, for he is at rest.
verses.12: But the wicked life of a wicked fool is worse than death.
verses.13: The mourning for the dead is seven days; but for the foolish and the impious, it is all the days of their life.
verses.14: You should not talk at length with the foolish, and you should not go with the senseless.
verses.15: Keep yourself from him, so that you may not have problems, and so that you will not be polluted by his sin.
verses.16: Turn away from him, and you will find rest, and you will not be discouraged by his foolishness.
verses.17: What is heavier than lead? And what else can he be called but foolish?
verses.18: Sand, and salt, and an iron weight are each easier to bear than an imprudent man, who is both foolish and impious.
verses.19: A bundle of wood strapped together in the foundation of a building will not be loosened. And similar is the heart that has been strengthened by thoughtful counsel.
verses.20: The thoughts of one who is understanding will not be corrupted by fear in any situation.
verses.21: Just as chaff in a high place, or a wall made of mortar without stones set within, will not continue against the face of the wind,
verses.22: so also a timid heart, and the thoughts of the senseless, will not withstand the forcefulness of fear.
verses.23: Despite a cowardly heart, the thoughts of the foolish will not fear any situation; yet neither will one who continues always in the precepts of God.
verses.24: He who jabs an eye produces tears. And he who jabs the heart produces understanding.
verses.25: He who throws a stone at birds will drive them away. So also, he who accuses his friend dissolves the friendship.
verses.26: But if you have drawn a sword against a friend, you should not despair; for there may be a way back.
verses.27: If you have opened a harsh mouth against a friend, you should not fear; for there may be a reconciliation. However, if there are accusations, or abuse, or arrogance, or the revealing of secrets, or a wound from deceitfulness, in all these cases, a friend will flee away.
verses.28: Hold to faithfulness with a friend in his poverty, so that you may also rejoice in his prosperity.
verses.29: In the time of his tribulation, remain faithful to him, so that you may also be an heir with him in his inheritance.
verses.30: Just as the steam from an oven, or the smoke from a fire, rises up before a flame, so also do curses and insults and threats rise up before bloodshed.
verses.31: I shall not be ashamed to greet a friend, nor shall I hide myself from his face. And if misfortunes befall me because of him, I will endure.
verses.32: Anyone who hears of this will be wary around him.
verses.33: Who will provide a keeper for my mouth, and a reliable seal over my lips, so that I may not fall because of them, and so that my tongue does not destroy me? [ Sirach 23 ]
